name: Risou no Kanojo 2026
source:
Spring of his second year at university, Takao starts dating Kaori, a classmate who dresses plainly but somehow draws the eye. Thinking she would be even more beautiful if she dressed up a little, he gives her clothes and shoes, but she rejects them: "Why isn't the way I am good enough?"

Three months after their breakup, Takao happens to see her again. She is wearing vivid clothes he has never seen before, along with the shoes he once gave her, and with a smile she gets into a luxury car waiting for her.

The story is told mainly from Takao's point of view; the second playthrough adds scenes from Kaori's side.
